newsitem.title: USA: Swisher International sets 6 mln share IPO.
newsitem.headline: Swisher International sets 6 mln share IPO.

text.p: Swisher International Group Inc said Monday it plans to sell up to six million Class A common shares in its initial public offering.

The cigar manufacturer, in an amended filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, said that of the total, 4.8 million common are being offered in the United States and Canada and 1.2 million common will be offered internationally.
The offering is estimated to be priced between $17 and $20 per share, the filing said.

The company has granted a 30-day over-allotment option to U.S. underwriters to purchase up to 720,000 additional Class A shares and to international underwriters 180,000 additional Class A shares, the filing said.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Salomon Brothers Inc and Forum Capital Markets LP.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total six million Class A common and 28.1 million Class B common for a combined 34.1 million shares of common stock.
It said its Class A stock has been approved for listing on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol SWR.N.
